```{r setup}
#| include: false

pacman::p_load(dplyr, tidyr, scales, purrr, stringr, here, knitr, kableExtra)

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ss.df     <- readRDS(here::here("clean data", "sens_spec_results.RDS"))
inc_df    <- readRDS(here::here("clean data", "inc_results3.RDS"))
risk_df   <- readRDS(here::here("clean data", "risk_results3.RDS"))
ve_df     <- readRDS(here::here("clean data", "ve_results3.RDS"))
sample.df <- readRDS(here::here("clean data", "sample_sizes3.RDS"))
sample.total.df <- readRDS(here::here("clean data", "sample_sizes3_comparison.RDS"))

# ── Label updates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
datasets <- c("ss.df", "inc_df", "risk_df", "ve_df", "sample.df", "sample.total.df")
for (d in datasets) {
  temp <- get(d)
  temp$severity[temp$severity == "MAL-ED Score >=6"] <- "Score-based MSD"
  temp$severity[temp$severity == "GEMS MSD"] <- "Criteria-based MSD"
  if ("endpoint" %in% names(temp))
    temp$endpoint <- gsub("Endpoint Culture", "Endpoint 5", temp$endpoint)
  assign(d, temp)
}

# ── Scenario factor labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dfs <- list(ss.df, inc_df, risk_df, ve_df, sample.df, sample.total.df)
dfs <- map(dfs, ~ .x %>%
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario,
    levels = c("Main","VE.inf0.0","VE.inf0.2","VE.dis0.3","VE.dis0.5",
               "VE.sev0.0","VE.sev0.3","VE.ct0.0","VE.ct0.2"),
    labels = c("Main","VEinf = 0%","VEinf = 20%","VEdis = 30%","VEdis = 50%",
               "VEmsd = 40%","VEmsd = 80%",
               "0% reduction in pathogen quantity",
               "20% reduction in pathogen quantity"))))
ss.df <- dfs[[1]]; inc_df <- dfs[[2]]; risk_df <- dfs[[3]]
ve_df  <- dfs[[4]]; sample.df <- dfs[[5]]; sample.total.df <- dfs[[6]]

# ── Build tables ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ── CI values use \makecell{est\pct{}\tbr{}(lo, hi)} so the 95% SI appears
# on a separate line. \pct{} and \tbr{} are preamble macros safe through pandoc.

# Helper: two-line CI cell value
ci_val <- function(mn, lo, hi)
  paste0("\\makecell{", sprintf("%.1f", 100*mn), "\\pct{}\\tbr{}(",
         sprintf("%.1f", 100*lo), ", ", sprintf("%.1f", 100*hi), ")}")

# Helper: format a numeric value (proportion, e.g. 0.233) as "23.3%", and for
# every non-Main scenario append the difference vs. the Main scenario for the
# same severity/endpoint, e.g. "22.2% (-1.1%)". The Main row itself just shows
# its value with no parenthetical (nothing to compare it to).
# Input df must have columns: severity, scenario, endpoint, val
fmt_val_vs_main <- function(df) {
  main_vals <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(scenario) == "Main") %>%
    select(severity, endpoint, main_val = val)

  df %>%
    left_join(main_vals, by = c("severity", "endpoint")) %>%
    mutate(
      diff  = 100 * (val - main_val),
      range = if_else(
        as.character(scenario) == "Main",
        paste0(sprintf("%.1f", 100 * val), "%"),
        paste0(sprintf("%.1f", 100 * val), "% (",
               ifelse(diff >= 0, "+", ""),
               sprintf("%.1f", diff), "%)")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-main_val, -diff)
}

# Helper: assign scenario group and abbreviated label for Tables 4-6
add_scenario_labels <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    scenario_group = factor(case_when(
      as.character(scenario) == "Main"       ~ "Main",
      grepl("VEinf", as.character(scenario)) ~ "VE against infection",
      grepl("VEdis", as.character(scenario)) ~ "VE against disease",
      grepl("VEmsd", as.character(scenario)) ~ "Target VE against MSD",
      TRUE                                   ~ "Reduction in pathogen quantity"),
      levels = c("Main", "VE against infection", "VE against disease",
                 "Target VE against MSD", "Reduction in pathogen quantity")),
    # Abbreviated scenario label (group header provides context)
    scenario_short = case_when(
      as.character(scenario) == "Main"        ~ "Main",
      grepl("= 0%",  as.character(scenario))  ~ "0%",
      grepl("= 20%", as.character(scenario))  ~ "20%",
      grepl("= 30%", as.character(scenario))  ~ "30%",
      grepl("= 50%", as.character(scenario))  ~ "50%",
      grepl("= 40%", as.character(scenario))  ~ "40%",
      grepl("= 80%", as.character(scenario))  ~ "80%",
      grepl("^0%",   as.character(scenario))  ~ "0%",
      grepl("^20%",  as.character(scenario))  ~ "20%",
      TRUE ~ as.character(scenario)
    )
  )
}

# Tables 1A & 1B: sensitivity / specificity (main scenario), two-line CI values
make_ss_tbl <- function(m) {
  ss.df %>%
    filter(scenario == "Main", measure == m) %>%
    mutate(val = ci_val(mean, lower, upper)) %>%
    select(severity, country_id, endpoint, val) %>%
    distinct() %>% arrange(severity, country_id, endpoint) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "endpoint", values_from = "val")
}
main.ss.sens.tbl <- make_ss_tbl("Sensitivity")
main.ss.spec.tbl <- make_ss_tbl("Specificity")

# Table 2: True VE (single line) and Observed VE (two-line CI)
main.ve.tbl <- ve_df %>%
  filter(scenario == "Main") %>%
  filter(measure == "Observed VE" |
           (measure == "True VE" & grepl("^Endpoint 1:", endpoint))) %>%
  mutate(endpoint = ifelse(measure == "True VE" & grepl("^Endpoint 1:", endpoint),
                           "AATrue VE", endpoint)) %>%
  mutate(val = ifelse(endpoint == "AATrue VE",
    paste0("\\makecell{", sprintf("%.1f", 100*mean), "\\pct{}}"),
    ci_val(mean, lower, upper))) %>%
  select(severity, country_id, endpoint, val) %>%
  distinct() %>% arrange(severity, country_id, endpoint) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "endpoint", values_from = "val",
              names_sep = "|||") |>
  rename(`True VE` = `AATrue VE`)

# Table 3: VE bias (two-line CI values)
main.ve.bias.tbl <- ve_df %>%
  filter(scenario == "Main", measure == "VE Bias") %>%
  mutate(val = ci_val(mean, lower, upper)) %>%
  select(severity, country_id, endpoint, val) %>%
  distinct() %>% arrange(severity, country_id, endpoint) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "endpoint", values_from = "val")

# Tables 4A & 4B: sens/spec ranges — severity column, scenario group headers
make_ss_range_tbl <- function(m) {
  ss.df %>%
    filter(measure == m, country_id == "All Sites") %>%
    group_by(severity, scenario, endpoint) %>%
    summarise(val = min(mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
    fmt_val_vs_main() %>%
    select(severity, scenario, endpoint, range) %>%
    add_scenario_labels() %>%
    arrange(severity, scenario_group, scenario, endpoint) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "endpoint", values_from = "range") %>%
    select(severity, scenario_group, scenario_short, everything()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-scenario)
}
ss.sens.tbl <- make_ss_range_tbl("Sensitivity")
ss.spec.tbl <- make_ss_range_tbl("Specificity")

# Table 5: VE bias ranges — severity column, scenario group headers
ve.bias.tbl <- ve_df %>%
  filter(measure == "VE Bias", country_id == "All Sites") %>%
  group_by(severity, scenario, endpoint) %>%
  summarise(val = min(mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  fmt_val_vs_main() %>%
  select(severity, scenario, endpoint, range) %>%
  add_scenario_labels() %>%
  arrange(severity, scenario_group, scenario, endpoint) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "endpoint", values_from = "range") %>%
  select(severity, scenario_group, scenario_short, everything()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-scenario)

# Table 6: sample size % differences — severity column, scenario group headers
sample.tbl <- sample.total.df %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  mutate(min_n    = min(ntotal_sum_of_sites),
         pct_diff = (ntotal_sum_of_sites - min_n) / ((ntotal_sum_of_sites + min_n) / 2)) %>%
  group_by(severity, scenario, endpoint) %>%
  mutate(range = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", 100*min(pct_diff)),"%")) %>%
  select(severity, scenario, endpoint, range) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  add_scenario_labels() %>%
  arrange(severity, scenario_group, scenario) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "endpoint", values_from = "range") %>%
  select(severity, scenario_group, scenario_short, everything()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-scenario)

# ── Formatting helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Convert endpoint name to \makecell{} with logical line breaks.
# Uses \tbr{} (defined in preamble as \\) instead of \\ directly, so
# pandoc never sees the double-backslash and cannot mangle it.
format_ep <- function(ep_name) {
  ep <- trimws(gsub("  +", " ", gsub("[\n]", " ", ep_name)))
  ep <- sub("(Endpoint [^:]+:) +", "\\1\n", ep)
  ep <- gsub("no ", "no\n", ep)
  lines <- strsplit(ep, "\n")[[1]]
  paste0("\\makecell{", paste(lines, collapse = "\\tbr{}"), "}")
}

# Escape % -> \pct{} in all character/factor columns.
# Uses \pct{} (defined in preamble as \%) instead of \% directly, so
# pandoc cannot convert \% back to a bare % (LaTeX comment character).
esc <- function(df) {
  as.data.frame(lapply(df, function(col) {
    if (is.character(col) || is.factor(col))
      gsub("%", "\\pct{}", as.character(col), fixed = TRUE)
    else col
  }), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

id_label <- function(col) switch(col,
  country_id = "Country", scenario = "Vaccine Scenario",
  severity = "Severity", col)

# Standard landscape kable — pack_rows on id_cols[1], displays id_cols[-1].
# id_col_widths: named list e.g. list("1"="2cm","2"="1cm") for column widths.
make_ep_kable <- function(df, id_cols, caption, footnote, fontsize = 9,
                           id_col_widths = NULL, footnote_escape = TRUE) {
  ep_cols    <- setdiff(names(df), id_cols)
  ep_latex   <- sapply(ep_cols, format_ep, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  grp_rle    <- rle(as.character(df[[id_cols[1]]]))
  display_df <- esc(df[, c(id_cols[-1], ep_cols), drop = FALSE])
  id_disp    <- sapply(id_cols[-1], id_label, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  k <- kable(display_df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
             caption = caption, col.names = c(id_disp, ep_latex),
             linesep = "", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"),
              font_size = fontsize, full_width = FALSE)

  if (!is.null(id_col_widths))
    for (nm in names(id_col_widths))
      k <- column_spec(k, as.integer(nm), width = id_col_widths[[nm]])

  row_start <- 1L
  for (i in seq_along(grp_rle$lengths)) {
    k <- pack_rows(k, grp_rle$values[i], row_start,
                   row_start + grp_rle$lengths[i] - 1L,
                   bold = TRUE, hline_before = TRUE, escape = TRUE)
    row_start <- row_start + grp_rle$lengths[i]
  }

  k <- footnote(k,
                general = footnote,
                general_title = "",
                footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
                threeparttable = TRUE,
                escape = footnote_escape)

  k
}

# Specialist kable for Tables 4-6.
# Layout (matching old supplement):
#   - TWO id columns: severity (collapsed to show once per block via
#     collapse_rows) and vaccine scenario.
#   - Scenario group categories (VE against infection, etc.) are inserted as
#     explicit bold rows in the scenario column, with blank endpoint cells.
#   - Individual scenario values (0%, 20%, …) appear as plain rows below.
#   - collapse_rows() on column 1 produces the merged "All diarrhea" cell.
make_scenario_kable <- function(df, caption, footnote, fontsize = 9,
                                footnote_escape = TRUE) {
  ep_cols  <- setdiff(names(df), c("severity", "scenario_group", "scenario_short"))
  ep_latex <- sapply(ep_cols, format_ep, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  # Build display dataframe: insert a header row before each non-Main group
  rows_out <- list()
  is_hdr   <- logical(0)

  for (sev in unique(df$severity)) {
    sev_df  <- df[df$severity == sev, ]
    grp_rle <- rle(as.character(sev_df$scenario_group))
    ptr     <- 1L

    for (g in seq_along(grp_rle$lengths)) {
      n         <- grp_rle$lengths[g]
      grp_label <- grp_rle$values[g]

      if (grp_label != "Main") {
        # Header row: severity + group label, blank endpoint cells
        hdr <- data.frame(severity = sev, scenario_short = grp_label,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        for (ep in ep_cols) hdr[[ep]] <- ""
        rows_out <- c(rows_out, list(hdr))
        is_hdr   <- c(is_hdr, TRUE)
      }

      data_part <- sev_df[ptr:(ptr + n - 1L),
                          c("severity", "scenario_short", ep_cols),
                          drop = FALSE]
      rows_out <- c(rows_out, list(data_part))
      is_hdr   <- c(is_hdr, rep(FALSE, n))
      ptr      <- ptr + n
    }
  }

  disp_df   <- esc(do.call(rbind, rows_out))
  col_names <- c("Severity", "Vaccine Scenario", ep_latex)
  hdr_rows  <- which(is_hdr)

  k <- kable(disp_df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
             caption = caption, col.names = col_names,
             linesep = "", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"),
              font_size = fontsize, full_width = FALSE) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "1.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "4cm") %>%
    column_spec(3:ncol(disp_df), latex_column_spec = "c") %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "middle")

  for (r in hdr_rows)
    k <- row_spec(k, r, bold = TRUE)

  k <- footnote(k,
                general = footnote,
                general_title = "",
                footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
                threeparttable = TRUE,
                escape = footnote_escape)

  k
}
```

```{r tbl1a}
  id_cols = c("severity", "country_id"),

    "Supplementary Table 1A. Sensitivity of each proposed endpoint to distinguish ",
    "true Shigella diarrhea of any severity (all diarrhea), criteria-based MSD, ",
    "and score-based MSD."),
  footnote = paste0("Values are mean (95% simulation interval) across countries for the main ",
    "vaccine scenario."),
  fontsize = 9
)
```
